query: SELECT count(*) AS "total!" FROM alerts WHERE (cardinality($1::text[]) = 0 OR status = ANY($1)) AND (cardinality($2::text[]) = 0 OR severity = ANY($2)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest($3::text[], $4::text[], $5::bool[]) AS matcher (name, value, equal) WHERE (COALESCE(alerts.labels ->> matcher.name, '') = matcher.value) <> matcher.equal) AND ($6::text IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications WHERE notifications.dedupe_key = 'a:' || alerts.fingerprint AND notifications.state = $6))
